Burst |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]4 |burst = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Burst]]5 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.4 |cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Cooldown]]0.8 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]22 |speed = 4 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Level 0+}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Level 0+}} (Collision only) |flying = N/A }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gunner Elf''' is one of the final units that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Level 3-4, replacing the [[Cannoneer Elf]]. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. It has a spawnrate of 25 seconds. The '''Gunner Elf''' fires in bursts of 5. Whenever there are enemies in its range, the '''Gunner Elf''' will stop moving and attack enemies with its snowball launcher. As the snowballs fired by it are a projectile, they may not hit the intended target but a different enemy instead or miss an enemy entirely. It will continue walking when there are no enemies left in its range. Two '''Gunner Elves''' spawn each time starting from Level 4. These are not one unit, but two units. ==Appearance== The '''Gunner Elf''' has dark skin and brown hair. It wears a green shirt with a brown belt and red details, green and red hat with golden stars and goggles on top, dark green pants and brown shoes. It wields a snowball cannon that it attacks enemies with. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = (Damage * Burst Count) / (Cooldown + (Firerate * Burst Count)) $RAM$ = Health / Spawnrate $REF$ = DPS is calculated as (Damage × Burst Count) ÷ (Cooldown + (Firerate × Burst Count)).

}} ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:GunnerElf.png|175px]] |[[File:ChocolatierGunnerElf.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} |{{Color|Valentines2026|Chocolatier}} |- !Obtained From |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |[[Valentines 2026 Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The two '''Gunner Elves''' that spawn can be quite useful during the mid to late-game because of their high range and DPS. *On two-pathed maps, only one/two '''Gunner Elves''' will spawn per Level 3-4 [[Elf Camp]]. Each one will go down a random path. *The '''Gunner Elf''' has hidden , making them quite useful against such enemies. **The '''Gunner Elf''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies like [[Soul]]s, but it can attack them. *The '''Gunner Elf''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. **Its gun damage is still affected. *The '''Gunner Elf''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *The '''Gunner Elf''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Gunner Elf''' is caught in the attack, it will die instantly regardless of how much health it has. ==Trivia== *The '''Gunner Elf''' is the first unit to have hidden detection. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''21 December 2022''' -
